features.title: Welcome to Caelestia Updates
features.description: Whenever we introduce exciting new features, they will appear here so you never miss out. Enjoy the refined aesthetic and improved functionality!

features.title: Smarter AI Assistant
features.description: Your AI assistant just got a massive upgrade. It now understands context better, responds faster, and seamlessly integrates with your active workspace.

features.title: Dynamic Material Theming
features.description: Caelestia now fully supports Material You dynamic theming. Your entire shell will dynamically adjust its colors based on your wallpaper, creating a beautifully cohesive experience.

features.title: Refined Widgets
features.description: All your favorite widgets have been given a fresh coat of paint. Enjoy smoother animations, better spacing, and a cleaner overall aesthetic that feels truly premium.

features.title: Under-The-Hood Improvements
features.description: We've heavily optimized the QML rendering engine to ensure that your shell runs buttery smooth, even on lower-end hardware. Expect significantly lower memory usage!
